blockBottomSpacing.note: Vertical spacing step below the block (negative overlaps the next block).

blockTopSpacing.note: Vertical spacing step above the block (negative overlaps the previous block).

className.note: No curated vocabulary for this attribute — type and default only. Author a value and prove it with `wp pixelgrade blocks canonicalize` / `validate`.

colorSignal.note: Contextual color intent relative to the parent. Default anchors map signal→variation 0→1, 1→3, 2→8, 3→11. Max is getMaxSignal(palette) (default 3); a block may clamp via supports minColorSignal/maxColorSignal.

contentAlignment.note: No curated vocabulary for this attribute — type and default only. Author a value and prove it with `wp pixelgrade blocks canonicalize` / `validate`.

contentAreaWidth.note: Content column width as a % of the media area, on split (media + content) layouts.

contentColorSignal.note: Color signal of the block's content area (hosts with contentColorSignal support, e.g. Supernova).

contentDirection.note: No curated vocabulary for this attribute — type and default only. Author a value and prove it with `wp pixelgrade blocks canonicalize` / `validate`.

contentPaletteVariation.note: Resolved grade of the content area; keep consistent with contentColorSignal.

emphasisArea.note: Percentage of block width covered by the colored background. Only meaningful on horizontal Supernova cards (cardLayout horizontal / horizontal-reverse).

emphasisBottomSpacing.note: Content-area bottom spacing, in half steps. Min is -3 only when the block supports advancedSpacing, otherwise 0.

emphasisBySpace.note: No curated vocabulary for this attribute — type and default only. Author a value and prove it with `wp pixelgrade blocks canonicalize` / `validate`.

emphasisTopSpacing.note: Content-area top spacing, in half steps. Min is -3 only when the block supports advancedSpacing, otherwise 0.
